export function useLoginWorkspaceText() {
	const i18n = useAsamProI18n({ 'zh-CN': messages(zh), en: messages(en) });
	function t(key: 'cooldown', parameters: { seconds: number }): string;
	function t(key: Exclude<keyof typeof zh, 'cooldown'>): string;
	function t(key: keyof typeof zh, parameters?: { seconds: number }): string {
		return key === 'cooldown'
			? i18n.t('app.templates.loginWorkspace.cooldown', { seconds: parameters?.seconds ?? 0 })
			: i18n.t(...([`app.templates.loginWorkspace.${key}`] as Parameters<AsamI18n['t']>));
	}
	return { i18n, t };
}
